examGuide.title: Approach the exam question
examGuide.body: Use strict key bounds when reconstructing a BST from preorder or insertion order. Inorder is fixed by the sorted key set, while shape and other traversals depend on insertion order. A successor is the leftmost node of a right subtree, or the first ancestor reached from a left branch.

examGuide.title: Worked problem
examGuide.body:
Insert 20,10,30,5,15,12 into an empty BST. How many edges are on the root-to-12 path?

**Answer: 3.** The search path is 20→10→15→12. It contains three edges. Insertion of 12 uses comparisons against 20,10,15 before attaching it as the left child of 15.

examGuide.title: Conditions and edge cases
examGuide.body:
An ordinary BST need not be balanced. Worst-case height and search cost can be linear even with distinct keys.

A BST is not guaranteed to be balanced unless a balancing scheme is explicitly specified.
